explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 52 configurations over 7 sweeps (pipeline-topology, batch-caps, kv-capacity, moe-collective, prefix-cache, prefill-chunking, cudagraph), each at 5 load levels, every run on exactly 8 GPUs.
1x TP8 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8), from the kv-capacity sweep, reached 11.8 tok/s/accelerator (94.4 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 16 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
1x TP8 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8) at concurrency 16. 240 of 260 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: TP8 should peak highest, since each pipeline stage adds a boundary hop to every decode step.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP at 10.34 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 16).
sections.title: Sweep: pipeline-topology

prose: A seq cap of 8 should bind on TP8 at 16+ lanes, while a small token budget trades throughput for tail ITL on both shapes.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP at 10.44 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 16).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-caps

prose: fp8 KV should matter most on TP8, where 0.95 leaves almost no KV room, and substitute for memory on the pp shapes.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8) at 11.8 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 16).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-capacity

prose: DeepEP low-latency should win at small decode batches on both shapes, and matter more at EP width 8 than 4.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP at 10.34 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 16).
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: Turning the prefix cache off should collapse throughput on every shape, since AgentX re-sends a growing shared context.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP at 9.31 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: prefix-cache

prose: Capping long prefills should trade a little peak throughput for a much lower ITL p99 at saturation.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xPP2 + EP (prefill chunk 8,192) at 10.34 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 16).
sections.title: Sweep: prefill-chunking

prose: FULL-family capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP (graph capture full) at 9.28 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 8).
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph
